note: One spec for success and failure. The session evidence is required on every path. Each treatment's records -- its search record, structural record, recovered width projections, state journal and telemetry -- are required as patterns with at least zero matches (an early failure legitimately produced none) and are pulled off-pod by the launcher's poll hook as each treatment finishes. The materialized states (5-7 GB each at the root) are deliberately NOT collected: no consumer reads them after the structural record is written.
